headlineHtml: A real website, built and run for you
subtext: For local businesses who need a proper site online but don't have time to brief a designer, wait on approvals, or manage hosting.
points: Pick a design, add your content, live the same day
Every contact form lead saved and emailed to you
Edit your content or switch designs any time, yourself

captions.instagram:
Introducing Launchly 👋 A real website for your business — pick a design, add your content, and it's live the same day. No designer, no approval queue, no hosting to figure out. Leads from your contact form land straight in your inbox.
#localbusiness #webdesign #smallbusiness
captions.facebook: If your business doesn't have a proper website yet, here's what we've been building: Launchly. Pick one of our designs, add your own content, and your site is live that same day — no waiting on a designer, no approval process. Every message a customer sends through your contact form gets saved and emailed straight to you. And if you ever want to change your content or switch to a different design, you can do that yourself, any time, from your dashboard.
captions.twitter: Introducing Launchly: pick a design, add your content, your business has a real website live the same day. No designer, no approval queue, no hosting headaches. Contact form leads land in your inbox automatically.
captions.linkedin: I've been building Launchly — a self-serve website builder for local businesses. The idea: a business owner shouldn't need to brief a designer, wait on an approval process, or think about hosting just to get a real website online. Pick a design, add your content, and you're live the same day. Every lead from your contact form gets saved and emailed to you automatically, and you can update your content or switch designs yourself, whenever you want. Excited to start sharing more of what we're building.
